headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
dek: Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis, per The Guardian and CNBC.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The resignation
body: Jensen Huang resigned as chairman, CEO and board member of Nvidia, effective immediately, per The Guardian and CNBC.
CFO Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis (CNBC).

s3.title: What Nvidia did
s3.body: Per CNBC, The Verge and Engadget:

points.t: Harvey C. Jones becomes first chairman.
Seeks a permanent CEO, inside or out.
It does not mention the scandal (The Guardian).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Market reaction
body: Shares fell more than 10% and the value dipped below $4 trillion, per CNBC.
The Guardian says Nvidia supplies much of the world's AI chips.

items.t: Nvidia supplies AI chips worldwide (The Guardian).
Said he would hire Huang, per CNBC.

caption.hook: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, and shares fell more than 10%.
body: Per The Guardian, CNBC, The Verge, Wired, Engadget, TechRadar and Hipertextual, Huang left his posts as chairman, CEO and board member effective immediately, after two reports about his personal life. CFO Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis.

The board's statement does not mention the scandal, per The Guardian. Nvidia named Harvey C. Jones as board chairman and is searching for a permanent CEO, per CNBC. Shares fell more than 10%, below $4 trillion in market value, per CNBC.
